tasks.item: E2E runs only the affected specs
tasks.detail: From another project's learnings (U1): gate.json maps e2e specs to paths; a branch gate runs only the specs its change touches, anything unmapped or a config/contract change runs all; the ready PR's CI still runs all.

Bug found (U2): the gate diffed against the local base ref and never fetched, so results were recorded against a stale base and rejected. It now fetches the base first; offline it uses the local ref and says so.
